text:
devon: Heads-up — planning a staggered canary for model v13 tomorrow 09:00 UTC. Strategy: region-first (NA -> EU -> APAC) with tier splits (internal beta 1%, paid 5%, public 10%).

anya: OK. Can we add a customer-pin whitelist so we don't flip pinned accounts? :eyes:

devon: yes, will scope flag to respect customer_pinned_model metadata. Flag name: model_v13_toggle.

sam: leaving a quick rollback snippet (run from ops):
```
# rollback to v12
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  https://admin.redwood/api/flags/toggle \
  -d '{"flag":"model_v13_toggle","percent":0,"regions":["*"]}'
```

maria: Telemetry ask — need token-level latency + 5xx per-region alerts during ramp. Can we wire that to alerting playbook?

isabel: added to the playbook checklist. Thresholds proposed: latency p95 > 1.2x baseline OR error rate > 0.5% = cut 50% traffic. Escalate to oncall if auto-cut happens.

devon: good. Also enabling KV prefix cache warming for v13 in NA to reduce cold-start spikes.

deploy-bot: Flag created: model_v13_toggle (scopes: regions NA,EU,APAC; default: 0%). Creator: devon.

anya: small ask — canary percent ramp plan per window? Suggest: NA: 1% -> 5% -> 10% over 30m intervals. EU/APAC wait for NA green 1h.

devon: agreed. Documenting schedule in the rollout doc and setting canary guardrails. Will set automated pause checks after each increase.

sam: for safety, pin an emergency cutoff that sets percent=0 and posts to #incidents. I can wire a lambda to the alerting webhook.

oncall-bot: Reminder: oncall window for tomorrow 08:30-12:30 UTC assigned to @isabel.

isabel: I'll be oncall and monitoring the flow. Please post the canary runbook link here before kick.

devon: runbook link: https://go/redwood/runbooks/v13-canary (contains rollback play, metrics to watch, and tenant whitelist).

anya: quick QA: are API contract changes included? We tested answer schema parity in staging — no breaking changes.

maria: noted. I'll add the eval prompt set to the watch list for semantic regressions.

devon: thanks all. Final checklist: 1) flag created + whitelist (done) 2) telemetry alerts wired (maria) 3) rollback script (sam) 4) oncall assigned (isabel) 5) runbook link posted (done). If no objections, we kick tomorrow 09:00 UTC. :rocket:

isabel: +1

anya: +1

sam: +1
